method: Answer-level review against corrected gold, not a Ragas score threshold. Fully correct requires the requested facts; equivalent formats, appropriate missing-information refusals and harmless extra detail are accepted. Partial answers miss some requested facts. Incorrect_or_unanswered includes refusals on answerable questions, even if caused by retrieval misses.
limits: Development-set result on a revised, partially synthetic packet; not an unseen-packet benchmark or a separate full grounding audit. Review decisions are subjective and should be independently checked before broader claims.
